{{Spell InfoBox|image=High-pressure_Stream.png|type=Spell Projectiles|rarity=Normal|mana_cost1=24|mana_cost2=31|mana_cost3=40|dmg1=60 (DPS)|dmg2=120 (DPS)|dmg3=240 (DPS)|misc_a_1=Continuous Casting|misc_a_2=Continuous Casting|misc_a_3=Continuous Casting}}The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Normal]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Projectiles. When the default spell is cast, it fires a stream of water at the target.

'''Description:''' Don't underestimate the strength of water. Continuous attacks without interval are perfect for building combo spells of hitting. Water can also contain attached elements and leave traces on the ground.

WARNING: If combined with a [[Venom Crystal]] it will create poison fields all over the ground where it sprays, which can also damage you and your summons.
